evidence: Source: task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...) is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile; tests/test.sh, .dockerignore, tools/restart_mcp.py, tools/score.py, scoring.toml and every judge.toml [judge]/mcp_servers header are also identical to the template, and environment/Dockerfile is identical too. Every item check 22 names is present: (a) judge CLI, Dockerfile:17 '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281' (matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code" in task.toml:31; codex also at :18); (b) Playwright MCP, Dockerfile:19 '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79', which is the 'playwright-mcp' command every judge.toml invokes; (c) browser, Dockerfile:33-38 installs chromium from the Playwright bundled in that pinned MCP package ('node "$PW_CLI" install --with-deps chromium'), makes it world readable and links it to /usr/local/bin/chromium, exactly the '--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium' in the judge.toml files, so the browser build is pinned transitively by the MCP version; (d) RewardKit, Dockerfile:31 'pip3 install --no-cache-dir harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7'; (e) python3 for the restart server, base 'FROM python:3.12-slim' gives /usr/local/bin/python3, the command in scored/functional/judge.toml, and test.sh's readiness probe; (f) app runtime, Dockerfile:1,4 copy Node 22 from node:22-bookworm-slim, Dockerfile:20-21 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (Dockerfile:9, test.sh:106), the same two packages at the same versions as environment/Dockerfile:10-11; (g) launch tooling test.sh uses: 'procps util-linux' (Dockerfile:13) provide setsid/setpriv, plus fonts-liberation (a monospace face for a code editor) and emoji fonts. Golden fit: solution/app/server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (lines 2-5); the frontend is prebuilt under public/ (index.html, assets/index.js, assets/index.css, runner.html), so the remaining package.json dependencies (prettier, acorn, @lezer/html, react, vite, typescript) are build-time or bundled and are not needed in the verifier image; solve.sh only copies files, no install or build at grade time. The golden's preview uses the localhost/127.0.0.1 alias on the same port 3000 (runtime.ts:391-392), so no second port or extra service is needed in the image. integration.md tells builders the same contract ('The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... Include everything needed at runtime'). Broken-app probe: an app lacking server.js or failing to answer on :3000 exits with the pre-written zero reward (test.sh:60-70, 115-125), so the image cannot grade a dead app as live. Conforming-alternative probe: an app carrying its own pure-JS or native modules in /app/node_modules built in the agent image (Node 22, bookworm) loads in the verifier (same Node 22 /usr/local tree; python:3.12-slim glibc is not older than bookworm's); node:sqlite is also available in Node 22; an app shelling out to the sqlite3 CLI or git (present only in the agent image) would fail, but integration.md publicly limits the supplied runtime, so that is not a hidden requirement. Runtime evidence (hashes in raw-evidence-index.json re-verified: result.json 4a9b1934..., verifier/reward.json bcfe3714..., scored/reward-details.json bacbf94c..., gates/reward-details.json 5b001eb8... all match): hosted run 4e686738 on an EARLIER candidate shows verifier/app.log 'Colderwater ready on port 3000', verifier/app-restart.log 'app-restart pid=1961 ready=1 at 2026-10-02T10:30:56Z', both suites graded and reward.json 'graded': 1, 'reward': 0.9833; this demonstrates that the template verifier image builds, launches this app family, drives Chromium through Playwright MCP, runs the claude-code judge and the python3 restart server. Limits kept as risk: (1) no verifier-image run exists for THESE bytes; the scripted golden ran 'in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image' (index limitation), and I could not byte-compare the earlier candidate's tests/Dockerfile, only infer equality from the template-controlled file; (2) base tags 'node:22-bookworm-slim' and 'python:3.12-slim' and apt packages are floating tags, not digests, so a later rebuild can differ from the measured one (template-controlled, unpinned apt is a NOTE under check-dockerfiles.py; pinning policy belongs to rows 10/47); (3) check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py was applied by hand (express and better-sqlite3 present at equal versions in both images), not executed. No Oracle, model or portal score is claimed for these bytes.
